option.name: originalContent
option.value:
<odoo> <!-- Custom Form View --> <record id="view_crm_lead_form_custom" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">crm.lead.form.custom</field> <field name="model">crm.lead</field> <field name="inherit_id" ref="crm.crm_lead_view_form"/> <field name="arch" type="xml">
<!-- Existing info before the notebook --> <xpath expr="//sheet/notebook" position="before"> <group colspan="2"> <group string="Contract Details"> <field name="contract_type" widget="radio"/> <field name="contract_months"/> <field name="expected_start_date"/> <field name="date_go_live"/> <field name="date_conversion"/> </group>
<group string="Service Information"> <field name="scope_of_service"/> <field name="freight_type" invisible="scope_of_service != 'freight_forwarding'"/> <field name="origin_country_id"/> <field name="destination_country_id"/> <field name="port_of_loading_id"/> <field name="port_of_destination_id"/> <field name="product"/> </group> </group>
<group colspan="2"> <group string="Additional Info"> <field name="dept_region"/> <field name="realized_revenue_fy2025"/> <field name="category_type"/> </group> </group> </xpath>
<!-- ✅ Fixed "Activities" tab --> <xpath expr="//sheet/notebook" position="inside"> <page string="Activities"> <field name="activity_ids" widget="mail_activity" nolabel="1"/> <field name="partner_id" widget="mail_activity" nolabel="1"/> </page> </xpath>
</field> </record>
<!-- Custom Tree View --> <record id="view_crm_lead_tree_custom" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">crm.lead.tree.custom</field> <field name="model">crm.lead</field> <field name="inherit_id" ref="crm.crm_case_tree_view_oppor"/> <field name="arch" type="xml"> <xpath expr="field[@name='partner_id']" position="replace"> <field name="team_id" invisible="1" optional="show"/> <field name="name" string="Project" optional="show"/> <field name="description" string="Remarks" optional="show"/> <field name="user_id" string="PIC" optional="show"/> <field name="create_date" string="Date Funnel" optional="show"/> <field name="expected_start_date" string="Expected Start Date" optional="show"/> <field name="date_conversion" string="Date Secured" optional="show"/> <field name="date_go_live" string="Date Go Live" optional="show"/> <field name="scope_of_service" string="Scope of service" optional="show"/> <field name="product" string="Product" optional="show"/> <field name="dept_region" string="Dept/region" optional="show"/> <field name="realized_revenue_fy2025" optional="show"/> <field name="category_type" optional="show"/> </xpath> </field> </record> </odoo>
